criteria.text: The stage accounts for all 138 measured formatting mismatches and 11 raw captures across owned children before final verification.
Raw LLM captures, generated assets, caches, tool state, installed agent assets, and immutable stage evidence are explicitly ignored without changing their tracked bytes.
All remaining docs, specs, and packages mismatches are changed only by the repository-pinned Prettier formatter.
pnpm format:check, pnpm type-check, and pnpm build exit zero on the final tree.
